CUnrar vendored source provenance
=================================

unrar/  — RARLAB UnRAR, source package "unrarsrc" version 7.2.4
  Upstream:  https://www.rarlab.com/rar_add.htm
  Tarball:   https://www.rarlab.com/rar/unrarsrc-7.2.4.tar.gz
  SHA-256:   b02e571a33af7711cd803080500370dc1d28eea82b2032480819d27462ad8b31
  Fetched:   2026-06-11
  License:   unrar/license.txt (the UnRAR source license — free for extraction,
             may NOT be used to develop a RAR/WinRAR-compatible archiver or to
             re-create the RAR compression algorithm; see the verbatim paragraph
             reproduced in THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.md and the app acknowledgements)

  Version naming note: the source *package* is 7.2.4; version.hpp inside it
  reports the engine as RAR/UnRAR 7.20 (2026-02-01). Both refer to the same
  release — RARLAB numbers the tarball and the engine differently.

LOCAL MODIFICATIONS (re-apply on any version bump — each is marked with a
"LOCAL PATCH (ModernPAR)" comment at the site; 1–2 reproduced with the
rar15-comment / rar202-comment-nopsw fixtures, which the unrar CLI lists and
extracts fine while the unpatched unrar.dll path returns ERAR_BAD_DATA; 3
reproduced with a mid-archive corruption fixture where every good file after
the corrupt one was silently dropped):
  1. arcread.cpp ReadHeader15 generic header-CRC check: skip HEAD_FILE /
     HEAD_SERVICE headers WHOSE CASE-BRANCH CRC CHECK PASSED (tracked by the
     patch-added FileHeaderCRCValid — old-style embedded file comments make
     the stored CRC cover only the processed part, so upstream's full-buffer
     re-check fails on perfectly good headers; genuinely corrupt file headers
     still take the generic block, preserving RARX_CRC classification and the
     FailedHeaderDecryption stop for encrypted headers) and a HEAD_MAIN with
     MHD_COMMENT (its comment bytes are deliberately not read into Raw, so
     the stored CRC cannot be verified from the buffer). Without the skips,
     every commented RAR 1.5-2.x archive silently set the sticky RARX_CRC
     error code, and unrar.dll's call tails
     (`RarErrorToDll(ErrHandler.GetErrorCode())`) then misreport every
     subsequent successful RARReadHeaderEx/RARProcessFile as BAD_DATA.
  2. dll.cpp RARReadHeaderEx end-of-search path: only return ERAR_BAD_DATA for
     a sticky Arc.BrokenHeader when CurBlockPos != FileLength(). BrokenHeader
     is a warning flag (the CLI keeps going on it); upstream's unconditional
     check turns a clean end-of-archive after any header warning into
     BAD_DATA. `!=` not `<`: a corrupt header whose garbage size fields jump
     PAST the end is still damage. (Known residual false negative: a garbage
     jump landing EXACTLY on FileLength() reads as a clean end.)
  3. dll.cpp RARReadHeaderEx: reset Data->Cmd.DllError=0 at the top of the try
     block, exactly as ProcessFile already does. Without it, a per-file error
     (one corrupt file mid-archive) stays in DllError and the function's
     success tail re-reports it for every following header, aborting
     keep-extracting loops — good files after the corrupt one were silently
     dropped while partial output was still delivered.
  4. arcread.cpp ReadHeader15 FILE-header branch (right after ConvertFileHeader):
     one block-scoped call to ModernPARCaptureRawEntryName(FileName.data(),
     strlen(FileName.data()), (hd->Flags & LHD_UNICODE)!=0), the hook being
     declared `extern` inside the same block and defined in ../UnrarShim.cpp.
     RAR 1.5-4.x headers without LHD_UNICODE store the name in an OEM/regional
     codepage only; on _APPLE CharToWide is UTF-8 (unicode.cpp UtfToWide), which
     TRUNCATES at the first invalid byte — an all-Cyrillic CP866 name reaches
     the DLL surface as an EMPTY FileNameW (and extraction of it then fails the
     whole run with ERAR_ECREATE), with the original bytes unrecoverable. The
     hook hands the raw bytes + the Unicode-name fact to the shim, which
     surfaces them per entry (UnrarShimEntry.raw_name/name_had_unicode) so
     ArchiveKit can decode legacy names with a user-chosen charset and redirect
     those entries via the dll DestName contract (RARProcessFileW 4th argument —
     a public DLL capability, no patch needed for the redirect itself).
     Reproduced by the synthesized CP866 RAR 1.5-format fixtures built in
     ArchiveKitTests/FilenameEncodingTests.swift. ReadHeader14 (ancient RAR 1.4
     archives) is deliberately not patched; such entries keep reporting
     name_had_unicode=1 / raw_name=NULL, i.e. today's behavior.
Related (shim-side, not a vendor patch): UnrarShim.cpp calls ErrHandler.Clean()
before each header read because the engine's global error state is sticky and
both call tails convert it into per-call return codes; and treats per-call
ERAR_UNKNOWN as a warning-class per-file skip (e.g. unsafe/absolute symlinks,
which the DLL policy never extracts) rather than a run-fatal error.
The shim (../include/unrarshim.h, ../UnrarShim.cpp) lives OUTSIDE vendor/ so
version bumps are otherwise a clean delete-and-replace of unrar/.

Build mapping (mirrors the upstream `makefile` `lib:` target):
  - Compiled translation units = OBJECTS + LIB_OBJ from the makefile
    (rar.cpp … largepage.cpp + filestr.cpp scantree.cpp dll.cpp qopen.cpp).
  - Everything else is EXCLUDED in Package.swift, because upstream #includes
    those .cpp files into other translation units (e.g. unpack15/20/30/50*.cpp
    into unpack.cpp, crypt1/2/3/5.cpp into crypt.cpp, uicommon/uisilent/
    uiconsole.cpp into ui.cpp, log.cpp into consio.cpp, arccmt.cpp into
    archive.cpp, blake2s_sse/blake2sp.cpp into blake2s.cpp, threadmisc.cpp
    into threadpool.cpp, recvol3/5.cpp into recvol.cpp) or they are not part
    of the lib build at all (recvol.cpp, rs.cpp, isnt.cpp, motw.cpp,
    rarpch.cpp, win32*.cpp, hardlinks.cpp/uowners.cpp/ulinks.cpp via
    extinfo.cpp, cmdfilter/cmdmix.cpp via cmddata.cpp, coder/model/suballoc/
    unpackinline.cpp via unpack.cpp, encname/sha1 ARE in OBJECTS).
  - Defines = -DRARDLL -DRAR_SMP -D_FILE_OFFSET_BITS=64 -D_LARGEFILE_SOURCE
    (RARDLL implies SILENT via os.hpp and disables the CLI main() in rar.cpp).

Thread-safety contract: the UnRAR DLL surface keeps process-global state
(ErrHandler is cleaned in RAROpenArchiveEx). Do NOT run two archive operations
concurrently in one process — ArchiveKit serializes every call on one queue.

On a version bump re-verify (cost real analysis the first time):
  1. The makefile OBJECTS/LIB_OBJ lists against Package.swift's exclude list.
  2. UCM_* callback contracts: UCM_NEEDPASSWORDW buffer is wchar[MAXPASSWORD]
     with P2 = capacity in wchars (extract.cpp ExtrDllGetPassword,
     arcread.cpp encrypted headers); UCM_CHANGEVOLUMEW ASK passes a
     MAXPATHSIZE wchar buffer (volume.cpp DllVolChange), return -1 aborts;
     UCM_PROCESSDATA return -1 cancels (rdwrfn.cpp); UCM_LARGEDICT P1/P2 are
     KiB, return 1 permits (uisilent.cpp uiDictLimit).
  3. _APPLE keeps WideToChar/CharToWide on UTF-8 (unicode.cpp), so paths are
     locale-independent — if that #ifdef changes, sandboxed apps (locale "C")
     would mangle non-ASCII names.
  4. ROADF_*/ERAR_* values in dll.hpp against the UNRARSHIM_* mirrors
     (static_asserts in UnrarShim.cpp will catch drift at compile time).
